messages:
zoe_ae: Newark Health POC stuck: their security team will only allow inference traffic if client cert auth (mTLS) is used. They refuse pure IP allowlisting. Can Dedicated support that for a short POC?

matt_se: Quick context: Dedicated can provide static NAT egress IPs quickly. We don't have an automated client-cert handshake for hosted/dedicated control plane endpoints, but we can do a manual certificate-fingerprint pin on the edge for a timeboxed POC (requires security exception). Private/VPC supports full mTLS.

newark-netops: Procurement won't spin up additional infra. They want the simplest option. If you can offer cert pinning + stable IPs we'll be happy.

lee_infra: We can reserve two /32 NAT IPs immediately. For cert pinning infra will need a maintenance window (~15m) to apply a manual TLS listener change. It's not standard but doable if security signs off.

ana_security: Security: we will approve a short-lived client cert for POC if: 1) TTL <= 7 days; 2) customer provides CSR (preferred); 3) exception form signed (SEC-POC-101); 4) revocation steps documented. We'll provide an audit extract of auth success events.

matt_se: Copy-paste allowlist snippet for Newark firewall team:

```
# NewarkHealth - Redwood Dedicated POC allowlist
198.51.100.90/32  # nat egress ip A
198.51.100.91/32  # nat egress ip B
# destination: dedicated-newark.pool.redwood.ai:443
```

matt_se: curl test for client-cert flow (if we enable pinning):

```
curl --cacert redwood-ca.pem \ 
  --cert newark-client.pem --key newark-client.key \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <DEDICATED-API-KEY>" 
  https://dedicated-newark.pool.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

newark-netops: Provide CSR template and exact CN/SAN expectations. We'll have our PKI issue immediately.

matt_se: CSR guidance: CN=newark-poc-client; SAN=email:newark-poc@newarkhealth.org (optional). Accept RSA2048 or ECDSA P-256. Deliver PEM CSR via secure upload.

lee_infra: Action items: open INF ticket to reserve NAT IPs and track manual TLS change (INF-5205). I'll also schedule the 15m window pending SEC-POC-101.

deploy-bot: [ticket] INF-5205 created by lee_infra - reserved NAT placeholders 198.51.100.90, 198.51.100.91

zoe_ae: I'll send Newark the allowlist, CSR template, and request the signed exception if they want cert pinning. Call scheduled 2025-12-03 11:00 ET to confirm. Thanks team.
